audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-5 are marked Skill/Ornn in both layers while every why-text for those rows says Garen wins them, and Level 6 is marked 'Skill' though the why says Ornn takes over.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn] at a 53.61% Garen win rate. Ornn is a scaling tank with a clunky early kit; Garen's Q silence and E out-trade him before Brittle and masterwork upgrades come online, and the lane flips at 6 for good.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 4-5 flip to Garen 6/10; Level 6 flips to Ornn 4/10, joining first item and 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volcanic Rupture is quoted at 10s and described only as 'wall-knockup setup'; nothing states that the pillar is his own terrain.
audit.why: Riot data: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s and carries terrain plus grounding — 'a magma pillar forms at the end location'. Searing Charge (14s at rank 1) knocks up only 'if Ornn collides with terrain while charging', so the pillar he just planted is the terrain he charges you into. That pairing, not a map wall alone, is the combo to stand clear of.
audit.corrected: 9s at rank 1; the danger is standing between Ornn and the pillar he has planted, because Searing Charge into it is the knock-up.

audit.why: Garen owns levels 1-5 and must convert the lead before Ornn's masterwork upgrades and Brittle scaling take over; the early/mid/late prose says exactly this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture at 9s and Searing Charge at 14s (rank 1) are the two timers that gate a Garen step-up; Call of the Forge God is 140s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Step-up advice now keyed to the 9s Q timer and the pillar it leaves behind.

edits.before: Track Ornn’s Volcanic Rupture (10s): Wall-knockup setup. Don’t get pinned. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture (9s at rank 1) plants a pillar he can Searing Charge into for the knock-up. Never stand beside it.

edits.before: Stand near walls for his Q. Get brittle-procced. Let him scale. The R buys fights, not poke — spend it like the last one in stock.
edits.after: Stand between him and his own Q pillar. Eat Brittle. Let him scale. The R buys fights, not poke — spend it like the last one in stock.

edits.before: Track his Ornn Ornn brittle furnace blasts and ultimate ram before you commit
edits.after: Track Volcanic Rupture (9s at rank 1) and his pillar line before you commit

edits.before: At 5 (Ornn cell) his brittle and item upgrades start out-tanking your damage.
edits.after: At 6 his R knock-up plus Brittle and free upgrades out-tank your damage.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God (R) gives him a knock-up and brittle detonation, and his upgraded items start out-valuing yours — the lane begins to slip.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God (140s at rank 1) knocks up, slows and applies Brittle, and his free masterwork gold out-values yours — the lane starts slipping here.
